about_the_game:
⚙️ FEATURES:

🧠 Turn-based combat inspired by arena classics

  • Attack, defend, special move — simple? Not at all.

  • Every turn changes your chance to hit.

  • RNG? Yes, but we call it the “glitch-driven combat engine.”

🩸 Life is tough. And short.

  • Health doesn’t automatically restore after every PvE fight.

  • You need healing items… or a Medic in your camp who takes care of you.

  • Died? You lose your reward and wake up with half health.

🏕 Build your own survivor empire

  • Build your Camp — the base of your digital survival.

  • Unlock buildings like Storage, Barracks, Medic, or upgrade your Base.

  • Each building improves your stats, unlocks new possibilities, and increases your chances of survival (which comes in handy).

⚔️ Raid and loot what’s left of civilization

  • Assemble a team, explore locations, fight, loot, survive.

🌍 Explore locations you’d never want to visit

  • You start in the Abandoned Neighborhood. But other places await, like:

  • A school full of zombified bullying,

  • A casino where you bet your life… literally.

  • Each location has:

    • Unique quests,

    • A unique final boss with a unique reward.

🧪 Quests

  • Choose from 3 different options for each quest — each with different chances and rewards.

  • Play it safe, or go all-in?

📥 So what are you waiting for?

  • Download GLITCHOUT. Join the glitch apocalypse.
    Smash NPCs missing their scripts. Convince the digital fridge you’re an admin.
    Build a camp where you’re king. Or at least not dead.

🎮 GLITCHOUT – Because when reality collapses, it’s time to survive the chaos.

short_description: GLITCHOUT is a post-apocalyptic MMO Idle RPG with turn-based combat, factions, base-building, and random chaos at every step. Here you might get attacked by an NPC missing its script, a drunken vacuum cleaner, or a TV boss.
supported_languages:
English*, Czech
*languages with full audio support
